suite: v27 formation, physical redeployment and live defense regressions

results.name: Friendly redeployment preview is read-only and exposes exact remaining roster and travel estimate
Mixed military clergy and trader party physically travels before joining friendly garrison
Redeployment crosses multiple owned sectors using an actual road route
Disconnected friendly destination cannot teleport a party through neutral territory
Redeployment rejects same enemy and neutral destinations without spending units
Invalid roster empty fractional negative unknown and oversized party all reject atomically
Every supported unit type can be redeployed without converting or duplicating its identity
Explicit military formation sends exactly chosen combat units and leaves other troops at home
Military formation does not accept civilians unavailable counts or standard bearer alone
Wall attack eligibility depends on selected ranged units rather than troops left behind
Legacy count military order remains playable for existing AI and saved workflows
Bribe preview agrees with consumed escrow and does not spend during inspection
Departure from an active defense cannot duplicate captured defender roster
Recruit finishing during defense joins active defenders and survives the next synchronization
A friendly reinforcement joins active defense once while clergy and traders remain civilians
Loss of deployment destination returns the party without adding it to enemy garrison
Loss of departure outpost does not prevent delivery to a surviving friendly destination
Loss of an intervening region cannot continue an unopposed deployment through enemy territory
Mid-edge redeployment recall preserves position and returns each unit exactly once
Redeployment status updates ETA without mutating state or advancing paused time
Save during mixed redeployment resumes byte-identical travel and arrival
Save after destination loss and recall preserves deterministic recovery
Active defense with newly trained soldiers remains reloadable and deterministic
Actual v24 v25 and v26 fixtures migrate without changing inventories reservations or moving agents
Malformed deployment roster route and owner saves reject before entering live play
Military redeploy and recall sequence conserves every party member over repeated trips
